# Can you sell this consumer product in the EU under the GPSR?

> Free EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) checker for online sellers: is your product in scope, is an EU responsible person behind it, and which basic duties are still open. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
